entries.0b5fd5fb3aadea0e: It states that its technical capabilities, which contribute to effective use of energy through its core business of insulation work and technology, have earned high trust from users across many industries. Beginning with Nippon Keikaru Co., Ltd., which manufactures calcium silicate thermal insulation materials, the group undertakes everything from material production to construction, and has a structure in which consolidated subsidiaries, including local corporations in Asia and other regions, handle construction work in Japan and overseas.

The company and consolidated subsidiaries, including local subsidiaries in Japan and Asia, are responsible for manufacturing materials and construction work in Japan and overseas. entries.54ddc38dd812caee: Starting in April 2024, it launched its medium-term management plan for fiscal years 2024 to 2026, and under the basic policy of 'investment that leads to future leaps forward,' it sets out three priority measures: sustainably strengthening its earnings base, deploying sustainable growth strategies, and strengthening its management base. It states that it is working to gather and share information to win decarbonization projects, and to develop heat-shielding technologies and construction methods related to hydrogen and ammonia, which may become future energy sources, among other things. The dividend policy for the medium-term management plan period is stated, but as its content concerns future matters, it is not transcribed here.
